title: Wayfinder Trim HuD (Heads up Display)
description: Changes the textures of armor, hearts, hunger, and bubbles to match the Wayfinder Armor Trim.
body:
Changes the textures of armor, hearts, hunger, and bubbles to match the Wayfinder Armor Trim.

In the future, I want to make more armor trim resource/texture packs.

As always, it should work in most versions.
